text:
maddie (partnerships): Ok team — quick kickoff: NovaSystems + CloudX bench collaboration. Objective: produce reproducible perf/W and throughput stories we can use in a joint marketplace listing and a blog/exec one-pager. Target 6-week window.

josh (hw-partner): ✅ NovaSystems ready to share FW images and power telemetry. Need the test harness details.

anna (eng-runtime): High level: we'll run three workloads — chat(4k seq), batch-embedding(1k batch), and long-context(32k). Measure p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s), and watts/steady-state.

kevin (infra): Infra ask: dedicated rack in our lab w/ isolated network. We need VLAN + service account for Nova to push images. ETA for setup ~4 days.

ryan (eng-ml): For fairness, we should pin model weights and tokenization. Suggest: open-ggml-13B-v2 @ commit abc123 and tokenizers v0.12. We'll include a reproducibility manifest.

carla (SI): SI integration note — we'll validate deployment templates (Terraform + Helm) and do a smoke deploy. Also can help run customer-like mixes.

maddie (partnerships): Good. Also want a shared narrative: 1) perf/W improvement from kernel tuning, 2) throughput at scale with batching, 3) deterministic regression tests for quality. Who owns the writeup?

anna (eng-runtime): I'll draft the technical appendix (kernel flags, quant configs, KV-cache settings).

josh (hw-partner): Nova will document power rails and thermal caps. We'll provide power sensor mapping and CSV export.

kevin (infra): Bench infra checklist (short):
```
- VLAN created
- lab-rack reserved
- SSO service principal for nova
- bench-bot integration enabled
```

bench-bot: bench job queued: crossv-2145-setup, monitoring->prom:9090, grafana->dash-2145.

ryan (eng-ml): Important: add deterministic prompt set for quality checks. We'll run 200 prompts and compare logits/outputs. If >3% divergence, mark as quality regression.

maddie (partnerships): Timeline proposal: week 0: infra + image exchange. week 1-2: kernel tuning sweeps. week 3: stability runs. week 4: telemetry cleanup & narrative draft. week 5-6: joint review and marketplace asset prep. Any blockers?

josh (hw-partner): Only blocker is access approval for Nova engineers to the rack. Send their gitlab SSO IDs.

carla (SI): SI ops will need runbook template. I'll attach example later, but it has steps for hw validation, metrics collection, and rollback criteria.

anna (eng-runtime): Quick config snippet for the tuning experiment:
```yaml
run_id: crossv-2145-tune-1
model: open-ggml-13B-v2
quant: q4_0
kernel_flags: [use_fast_attention, fused_kv]
batch_sizes: [1,8,32]
seq_len: 4096
power_sample_interval: 1s
```

kevin (infra): We'll expose power metrics at /metrics/power and have a prom job scrape every 5s during runs. Ensure timestamps are unix ms.

maddie (partnerships): Communication plan: public marketplace listing in 8 weeks, joint blog 9 weeks. Legal needs to review the co-branding claim — "up to X perf/W" requires the exact test numbers included. Coordinate with legal after week 4.

ryan (eng-ml): Also schedule a 60-min recorded demo with partner execs after stability runs. We'll capture graphs for p95/throughput/watts.

josh (hw-partner): Sending engineer list now. Expecting access by EOD tomorrow.

maddie (partnerships): Action items:
- anna: draft appendix + tuning plan (due +10 days)
- kevin: lab + prom endpoint (due +4 days)
- josh: engineer access + power sensor mapping (due +2 days)
- ryan: prompt set + quality gating script (due +7 days)
- carla: runbook template (due +5 days)

carla (SI): ack, will drop runbook in this thread when ready.

bench-bot: NOTE: retention rule applied — logs >30d archived to s3://redwood-bench-archives/crossv-2145/

maddie (partnerships): Great meeting. We'll sync weekly. I'll create calendar invite with 30min standups starting Monday. :calendar: :rocket:

anna (eng-runtime): one more note — let's tag all artifacts with `crossv-2145` so we can tie metrics -> git commits.

josh (hw-partner): agreed. We'll also capture fan-speed profiles per run.

kevin (infra): If anyone needs temporary elevated access to the rack, ping me here.

maddie (partnerships): Closing thread for now. Post any infra/validation failures here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
